title: feat(workforce): Add Enterprise Workforce Intelligence & Predictive Analytics Hub
body:
## Summary

Adds a full-featured Workforce Intelligence & Predictive Analytics dashboard to PaySphere.

### 5 Production Files (1,278 lines)

1. `workforceService.ts` (234 lines) — Types, seed data, CSV export, formatting helpers
2. `AttritionRiskHeatmap.tsx` (110 lines) — Department x tenure risk matrix with color-coded cells
3. `CompensationBenchmarks.tsx` (126 lines) — Salary range visualization with market band indicators
4. `HeadcountTrendChart.tsx` (207 lines) — Stacked area chart with department breakdown
5. `EnterpriseWorkforceIntelligencePage.tsx` (601 lines) — Main dashboard with 5 tabs, 6 KPIs

### Features
- **Overview** — Headcount stacked area chart, turnover breakdown, recent departures, attrition heatmap
- **Attrition** — Departure records with risk scores, exit reasons, replacement costs, and category filters
- **Compensation** — Salary benchmarks with P25/P50/P75/P90 ranges, market band indicators, budget impact
- **Hiring Speed** — Time-to-hire by department with avg/median/P90 metrics
- **Diversity** — Gender parity, ethnicity index, age diversity, leadership parity scores

### Route
`/enterprise/workforce-intelligence`
